text.content:
Sect: Independent

Calling themselves the Elois, the True Brujah claim to be the real heirs of their clan's founder, insisting the vampires who bear the Brujah name today descend instead from a bastard childe who diablerized their true progenitor. Sagacious and erudite scholars, the Elois once ruled Carthage as gods before its fall, and their long unlives since have been spent in cold, detached study rather than the passion their cousins are famed for. Their alliance with the Black Hand cult gave them shelter for a time; since that cult's collapse, the Elois have sought new accommodations, most notably an uneasy but productive alliance of shared interest with the Followers of Set.

Disciplines: Potence, Presence, Temporis

Advantage: The True Brujah are academics without peer, each receiving a free Academics Ability and one additional Ability in any Lore at no cost. Though solitary, the Elois value discourse highly, gathering as a bloodline roughly twice a century to debate philosophy, with smaller cells maintaining contact and mutual scholarly aid between those gatherings.

Disadvantage: The blood of the Elois numbs their passions even as it preserves their flesh, drawing them ever further from human feeling and from any true sense of right and wrong. Elois wishing to raise their Morality or Virtue traits must pay double the standard experience cost, and on all Conscience or Conviction challenges they must bid two extra Traits or automatically lose the bid. Those whose intellect finally divorces entirely from feeling are lost to the Beast, their vast learning consumed with them.

Organization: The bloodline is unknown to Kindred society at large, allowing its members to move covertly, sometimes posing as members of other clans. Dissension runs deep between ancient elders and those who wish to act, and recruitment has all but ceased as the bloodline's numbers slowly thin.
